title: teofurlan.com: home page directions
brief: Personal portfolio home for Teo Furlan: two legs (software with AI agents, hardware), personal-story thread from a kid at a computer to agents and robot arms; recruiter 10-second test.

artboards.title: Drafting sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Most original and tied to his hardware work; the drawing metaphor can feel technical and cool for the AI and story parts

artboards.title: Lab notebook
artboards.tradeoff: Warmest and strongest personal story; slower to scan, the two legs and contact sit lower than in the split layout

artboards.title: Two legs
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest recruiter scan, both legs above the fold; least personal, closest to a conventional dark portfolio

artboards.title: Drawing set
artboards.tradeoff: Round 2. Every section is a numbered sheet with its own small schematic; a title block tracks where you are. Coherent and general; risks feeling like a document more than a person

artboards.title: Exploded view
artboards.tradeoff: Round 2. The hero explodes into five labelled layers of Teo as you scroll, with a parts list that links to each section. Most memorable opening; the metaphor needs the scroll to land

artboards.title: Signal path
artboards.tradeoff: Round 2. One circuit trace runs from the 2004 photo through every section and lights up as you scroll. Strongest story thread; the trace competes with content on narrow screens

artboards.title: Cover and sheets (04 + 05)
artboards.tradeoff: Round 3. The exploded view is the cover; the body is the numbered sheet set with schematics and a title block. Dark blueprint and light paper themes with a toggle. Clear and complete; the cover effect only plays once, at the top

artboards.title: Exploded index (04 + 05)
artboards.tradeoff: Round 3. The exploded stack is a sticky side map; the plate for the current section lifts out as you read. Dark blueprint and light paper themes with a toggle. The scroll interaction explains the page all the way down; costs 280 px of width on desktop and a strip on phones
